sparse.specialist_construction: A5-exact (M119/M124/M139b): global M108 whitener; per-domain candidate pool (n_cap 20000, seed [11, domain]) restricted to the domain's train rows; dictionary = candidates in the [11,100] seeded-permutation order, first 512 atoms; triangle encode on GPU with the registered throttle; closed-form ridge lambda=1.0.

phase2.note: penalty selected on a validation slice (first 80% of the seeded fit-half permutation) by valid accuracy; refit on the whole fit half; evaluated on the eval half only.

gate.registered: fired if fused < global - 0.005 on the eval half, OR competence < identity, OR identity < random.
gate.consequence_fired: the integration layer does not recover the specialist gains (scoped negative).
gate.consequence_passed: the integration layer recovers the specialist gains.
